python3 - <<'PY' > /home/zhuhe/.cache/litchi-native-office.V1L32Z/native-rtf-latent-oracle.json
"""Independent ASCII catalog oracle for the pinned native Word RTF files."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path('test-data/microsoft-office')
manifest = json.loads((root / 'manifest.json').read_text())
output = []
fields = ['lsdlocked', 'lsdsemihidden', 'lsdunhideused', 'lsdqformat', 'lsdpriority']
for item in manifest['files']:
    if not item['path'].endswith('.rtf'):
        continue
    data = (root / item['path']).read_bytes()
    start = data.index(b'\\latentstyles')
    end = data.index(b'}}', start) + 2
    group = data[start:end]
    header, body = group.split(b'{\\lsdlockedexcept', 1)
    defaults = dict((key.decode(), int(value)) for key, value in re.findall(rb'\\(lsd[a-z]+)([0-9]+)', header))
    entries = []
    for entry in body[:-2].split(b';'):
        if not entry.strip():
            continue
        controls = dict((key.decode(), int(value)) for key, value in re.findall(rb'\\(lsdlocked|lsdsemihidden|lsdunhideused|lsdqformat|lsdpriority)([0-9]+)', entry))
        name = re.sub(rb'\\[a-z]+[0-9]+ ?', b'', entry).strip()
        assert b'\\' not in name and b'{' not in name and b'}' not in name
        name = name.decode('ascii')
        entries.append([name, *[controls.get(field) for field in fields]])
    canonical = json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    output.append({'fixture': item['path'], 'defaults': defaults, 'exceptions': len(entries), 'ordered_values_sha256': hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()})
assert len(output) == 15
print(json.dumps({'field_order': ['name', *fields], 'files': output}, indent=2))
PY
